_about: Domains that job systems send application email from (opportunity_app/application_inbox.py). Shipped and non-personal: the same for every student. A message is read when its sender's domain, or the host of any link in it, is one of these or a subdomain of one. Being listed only decides what is read; what may be acted on is decided by the sender's authentication, and only ats and assessment senders can authorize an automatic change. job_boards are never senders worth reading: they are left out of employer-domain suggestions, because a job URL on them says nothing about whose domain it is. reserved are the documentation domains, which belong to no employer either.
